entities.name: Andrzej Ciechanowiecki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrew Stanislaus Ciechanowiecki was a Polish-British nobleman, diplomat, and art historian. He was considered an authority on French baroque sculpture in the second half of the 20th century.
